notes.title: 🔧 Gamer Stop Simulator Prologue – New Update v0.16
notes.content:
Hello Dear Players! 🎮
This update brings several improvements aimed at enhancing performance and overall gameplay experience.
🐞 Hotfix Details
📍 Indicators: Bugs related to in-game indicators have been fixed. They now function more accurately and smoothly.

⚙️ Optimization Improvements: Additional performance updates have been implemented for a more stable and fluid game experience.

🆘 “I'm Stuck” Button: A new button has been added to help you escape if your character gets stuck! Make sure to enable it from the settings.

As always, thank you for your ongoing support and feedback. 💬
We’re excited to bring you more features and content very soon! 🚀

notes.title: 🔧 Gamer Stop Simulator Prologue – New Update v0.11
notes.content:
Hello Dear Players! 🎮
This small update has been released to fix some important bugs and further improve your gaming experience.
🐞 Hotfix Details
🎮 Retro Game Shelf: The pricing bug has been fixed. Old games are now sold at their true value.

📆 Calendar Tab FPS Issue: The drop in FPS when entering the calendar has been resolved. The game runs more smoothly.

🌍 Localization Updates: Spelling mistakes and translation issues in some languages have been corrected.

Thank you, as always, for your support and feedback. 💬

notes.title: 🔧 Gamer Stop Simulator Prologue – New Update v0.04
notes.content:
Hello Dear Players! 🎮
With this update, we had to make some changes due to an issue with the save system.
Unfortunately, these changes required a reset of your progression. We sincerely apologize for this and ask for your understanding. 🙏

From now on, you won’t experience any interruptions or bugs related to the save system; you can continue your game with confidence.

In addition, with this update:

Many UI issues reported by players have been fixed,

Various bugs have been resolved,

Overall stability and performance have been improved.

As always, thank you for your support and patience. ❤️
We look forward to bringing you more improvements and new content in future updates!
